free_tier.stated: 3,000 credits a day (about 90,000 a month) at up to 5 requests a second, no credit card; a Geocoding, Reverse Geocoding or Autocomplete request costs 1 credit, a map tile 0.25 credit, and an address inside a batch job 0.5 credit
free_tier.notes: the daily quota is soft: steady overuse brings a request to upgrade, and the account can be blocked if that is ignored. The next plan, API 10, is USD 59 a month for 10,000 credits a day at 12 requests a second.

per_object_cap.stated: a batch geocoding job takes up to 1000 addresses

egress.terms: not applicable: a query API metered in credits, not bytes

interface_detail: HTTPS to api.geoapify.com/v1/geocode/search and /reverse with the key in the apiKey parameter, and an asynchronous batch endpoint at /v1/batch/geocode/search (POST a job, GET the result as JSON or CSV); a request without a key answers HTTP 401 Invalid apiKey
tooling: any HTTP client; vendor NPM libraries, an API playground and a batch playground
chaining: 3,000 storable credits a day with no card: 3,000 single geocodes, or more addresses through batch jobs of up to 1000 at 0.5 credit each, with results kept with no limit; the same key serves map tiles at 4 tiles a credit. Bulk path: the batch endpoint, plus free country-by-country downloads of OSM-derived localities and postcodes

limits.value: 3,000 credits a day on the Free plan; a geocode is 1 credit and an address in a batch job 0.5 credit

binding_note: 5 requests a second allows far more than 3,000 credits in a day, so the daily credit quota is met first

identity_cost.detail: an account at myprojects.geoapify.com created with an email address, a password of at least 8 characters with its confirmation, an accepted-terms checkbox and a reCAPTCHA, or with Google or GitHub sign-in; a verification link is emailed after sign-up; no credit card for the Free plan

reliability_note: the daily quota is soft and the rate is not throttled at once, but steady overuse brings an upgrade request and the account can be blocked if it is ignored; spreading requests over several accounts or projects to stay on a lower plan can disable access
confidence_note: the pricing page, the pricing-details page, the batch geocoding docs, the terms, the homepage and the downloads pages were quoted on 2026-10-30; a keyless geocode answered HTTP 401, and the localities download directory answered HTTP 200 with a file listing. No account was opened, so no keyed geocode was made; one would move it to measured.
